admission.justification: A foreign master commit or merge could otherwise land without any leaf judgment on three distinct public routes.

applicability: Final, checkpoint and recorded converted master landings.
conditions: Final requires all canonical non-abandoned leaves; checkpoint/recorded routes select already landed leaves.
Recorded landing uses the supplied endpoints and the recorded series code base.
exclusions: Legacy sync records without produced heads retain their explicit admission.
Abandoned rows retain their separately governed policy.
statement: Final, checkpoint and recorded master landings run validator, staleness, the landing chain proof over landed leaves, and rule 5; merges must be sync heads, leaf history, or parent line; foreign commits are named.
